item.title: Doctors are ignoring new federal vaccine recommendations
item.description: The American Academy of Pediatrics has released its updated recommendations for childhood vaccinations, which are being followed by many states and doctors instead of the CDC's controversial new schedule, and include a new immunization against RSV and a few other minor adjustments. The post Doctors are ignoring new federal vaccine recommendations appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Local Girl Scout Tatum Opens Digital Cookie® Store
item.description: Local Girl Scout Tatum Dunn has launched her online Digital Cookie® storefront, making it easy for the community to support her Girl Scout journey while enjoying their favorite cookies. Through her personalized website, customers can order classic Girl Scout Cookies and have them shipped directly to their door. item.title: Atlanta Hawks win third straight, defeat Pacers 132-116
item.description: The Atlanta Hawks defeated the Indiana Pacers 132-116 on Monday night, extending their winning streak to three games, with CJ McCollum and Luke Kennard combining for 36 points off the bench. The post Atlanta Hawks win third straight, defeat Pacers 132-116 appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup can have an everlasting impact on Atlanta, says local organizations, companies
item.description: The FIFA World Cup 2026 will be held in Atlanta, with Bank of America, the World Affairs Council of Atlanta, and the Metro Atlanta Chamber of Commerce all expressing their support for the tournament and its potential economic impact on the city. The post 2026 FIFA World Cup can have an everlasting impact on Atlanta, says local organizations, companies appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ’Atlanta is where I wanted to be’: Falcons introduce new head coach Kevin Stefanski
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons introduced Kevin Stefanski as their new head coach, with Matt Ryan, the current President of Football, and former quarterback, expressing his confidence in Stefanski's communication skills and experience, while also retaining defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich. The post ’Atlanta is where I wanted to be’: Falcons introduce new head coach Kevin Stefanski appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Black Futures Month 2026: Empowering Black Voices in Tech and Creativity
item.description: Black Futures Month is a four-day summit celebrating Black culture, technology, and innovation, taking place February 5-8, 2026, at the Russell Innovation Center for Entrepreneurs, with a theme of "Designing Liberation" and a range of experiences including creative media showcases, STE(A)M training, civic conversations, and more. The post Black Futures Month 2026: Empowering Black Voices in Tech and Creativity appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: South Carolina measles outbreak is largest in US since measles was declared eliminated
item.description: South Carolina is experiencing the largest measles outbreak in the US since the disease was declared eliminated in 2000, with 789 cases reported and 18 people hospitalized, due to low vaccination rates. The post South Carolina measles outbreak is largest in US since measles was declared eliminated appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Amazon plans to invest $500 million into South Fulton project
item.description: Amazon is investing $500 million in an inactive warehouse in South Fulton, creating 750 jobs and generating nearly five times as much in tax receipts, with the help of a $16 million tax break from the Development Authority of Fulton County. The post Amazon plans to invest $500 million into South Fulton project appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘Saving Lives Day’ comes to the Georgia Capitol
item.description: State Representative Carl Gilliard and State Senator Donzella James held a "Saving Lives Day" press conference to highlight legislation aimed at improving public safety in Georgia, including Eric's ID Law, the Autism Missing Person Alert System Act, and the Daren Lewis Saving Lives Act.
